title: Business design
purpose: Introduce the concept and a practical way to apply it

slides.key_message: Business design connects customer value to sustainable business outcomes.
slides.title: Business design
slides.subtitle: A practical guide to creating value that works
slides.notes: An introductory overview for business leaders and practitioners.

slides.key_message: Business design connects customer value, delivery capability, and sustainable economics.
slides.title: Business design connects customer value, delivery capability, and sustainable economics.
slides.notes: Business design looks beyond the offer itself. It considers whether people value the offer, whether the organization can reliably deliver it, and whether the economics can sustain it.

slides.key_message: A coherent business brings customer value, delivery, and economics together.
slides.title: Design value, delivery, and economics together
slides.kicker: Three dimensions shape one coherent business
slides.notes: These dimensions are interdependent. A compelling proposition must be matched by capabilities and an economic model that can support its delivery.

slides.key_message: Business design turns an initial need into a tested, adaptable model.
slides.title: Move from insight to a tested business model
slides.notes: Treat the sequence as a learning loop, not a one-way handoff. Use evidence from customer conversations and practical tests to refine the offer, its delivery, and its economics.
